name: Airlock Bridge
description: Routes tool calls through Airlock for permission enforcement and human-in-the-loop approval

url.description: Airlock gateway base URL (overrides AIRLOCK_URL env var)

agent.description: Airlock agent profile to run as (overrides AIRLOCK_AGENT env var)

secret.description: Airlock API secret / Bearer token (overrides AIRLOCK_SECRET env var)
